label: HDMI in
description: Whatever is plugged into a USB HDMI capture dongle on this host -- a laptop, another Pi, a console -- as a picture on the wall; it needs the dongle, and is offered only where one is plugged in

size.label: Source size
size.description: What the source sends: the dongle stretches it to this, so match its shape

fps.label: Frames a second
fps.description: How often to capture; a still picture sends nothing however high

align.label: Align
align.description: Where the picture sits on a screen taller than its shape: against the top, centred, or against the bottom

motion.label: Moving size
motion.description: How many lines high the picture is sent while it moves: smaller is decoded sooner on the wall and leaves it room for other video, and is softer while it moves; a still is always sent whole

quality.label: Moving quality
quality.description: JPEG quality while the picture moves, 2 best to 31 worst: lower numbers are sharper and slower over wifi

sharpen.label: Sharpen
sharpen.description: How much to sharpen text once the picture stands still

rotate.label: Turn
rotate.description: Turn the picture, for a source that is itself turned
